unlocks: Unlock your Ultimate: 1 use per battle.
Last Stand: Survive a lethal hit with 1 HP once per battle. Disabled while passives are sealed.

blader.name: Blader
core: Deal 100% ATK damage. Gain 1 Hone stack on damage.
Deal 140% ATK damage. Restore HP equal to 2% of damage dealt. Gain 1 Focus stack on damage. Interrupt curses and advance mechanics.
Deal 300% ATK damage. Available after a successful parry. Consume Sharp Eye and Sixth Sense. Interrupt curses and advance mechanics.
Parry a physical attack to reduce its damage by 60%. Cannot parry magic attacks.
Parry a magic attack to reduce its damage by 60%. Cannot parry physical attacks.
Deal 600% ATK damage. Cancel the current attack or mechanic.
Evade the current attack and mechanic failure damage. Prevent new curses this turn.
extra: Gain 1 Energy, 1 Sharp Eye stack, and one Thrust use.
Negate the incoming attack. Gain 1 Energy, 1 Sharp Eye stack, Sixth Sense, 1 Hone stack, and one Thrust use. May trigger Blade Trance.
Lose 1 Energy per hit taken with the wrong parry type. Evaded hits cost no Energy.
Each stack gives your next Thrust +20% critical chance, up to +40%.
Thrust deals 20% more damage and restores HP equal to 1% of damage dealt.
passives: Gain 1 Hone when a basic attack deals damage or you land a Perfect Parry. Each stack adds +1% to your base 30% Perfect Parry chance. Max 40.
Gain 1 Focus when Slash deals damage. Each stack adds +1% to your Blade Trance chance. Max 20.

Perfect Parry has a 30% chance to trigger Blade Trance for 4 turns. Focus raises this chance. While active, gain +10% critical chance and +10% critical damage. Thrust is free and unrestricted. Keep 2 Sharp Eye stacks and Sixth Sense. Triggering it again refreshes the duration.

paladin.name: Paladin
core: Deal 220% ATK damage. Interrupt curses and advance mechanics.
Reduce incoming physical damage by 50%. Gain 1 Energy on a successful guard.
Reduce incoming magic damage by 50%. Gain 1 Energy on a successful guard.
Gain 1 Divine Punishment. For 3 turns, gain +40% DEF. Each Blessing stack also gives Smite +6% damage and +10% critical chance, up to 3 stacks.
Restore HP equal to 70 + 30% of DEF, rounded down. Resolves before incoming damage on a defense turn.
Cleanse debuffs and curses. Available when a removable effect is active.
Deal 600% ATK damage. Cancel the current attack or mechanic.
Evade the current attack and mechanic failure damage. Prevent new curses this turn.
extra: Every 8 stacks grant +10% Smite damage, up to +40%. Lasts for the battle.
At 16 Divine Punishment stacks, Smite becomes Divine Smite. It gains +10% critical chance and heals you for 1% of damage dealt.
passives: After surviving direct damage, gain a 50% chance to restore HP equal to 20 + 40% of DEF, rounded down.

berserker.name: Berserker
core: Deal 100% ATK damage. Curse interruption and mechanic progress +1.
Deal 150% ATK damage. Gain 2 Energy. Curse interruption and mechanic progress +1.
Deal 250% ATK damage. Gain 1 Energy. Restore HP equal to 1% of damage dealt. Curse interruption and mechanic progress +2.
Deal 500% ATK damage. Restore HP equal to 4% of damage dealt. Curse interruption and mechanic progress +2.
Reduce incoming physical and magic damage by 40%. Preserve Charge. Gain 1 Charge level after surviving a heavy attack.

Spend 25% of your current HP without dying. Gain 1 Charge per 3 Energy spent. Each Energy gives your next basic or charged attack +5% critical chance. The bonus stacks up to +50% and ends when you attack.

Deal 550% ATK damage. Consume all Charge. Cancel the current attack, curse, or mechanic. On an attack turn, gain 2 bonus attacks on first use and 1 on reuse. Bonus attacks deal 50% more damage without a boss attack. No bonus attacks on a defense turn.
Evade the current attack and mechanic failure damage. Prevent new curses this turn. Preserve Charge.
extra: Charged Attacks consume all Charge. Two consecutive unguarded normal hits, or an unguarded heavy or special hit, clear Charge. Tackle and Emergency Evade preserve Charge.
passives: While HP is at or below min(60, 50 + DEF × 0.1)%: ATK +40% and direct damage taken reduced by 60%. Disabled while passives are sealed.
